name: area_interior_getblocklink
evidence: Reads the interior block (sector+0xc00 ints) and follows 0xc0000000 link entries by recursing into area_interior_getblock, same as the ELF area_interior_getblocklink; currently named clamp.

name: building_setupbuild
evidence: Called by createlevel right after area_createblock and after building_load where the ELF calls building_setupbuild; also uses __alloca_probe for large local arrays. Currently named area_getblock (the real area_getblock is 0x1850).

name: building_setupfloorplannewer
evidence: Called by createlevel just before building_buildfloorplan where the ELF calls building_setupfloorplannewer; copies 0x1200-byte floorplan records field by field. Currently named area_setblock (the real area_setblock is 0x296f0).

name: economy_gunmarket
evidence: Initialises the fixed 7-entry inventory of buildings of type 7 (stride 0x9dc), same as the ELF economy_gunmarket; currently named economy_carmarket (the car market is 0x5700).

name: createevent_updatestocks
evidence: Loops five stock entries then emits event type 0xd with packed stock values, same as the ELF createevent_updatestocks; currently named playerdebt.

name: createevent_updatecarmarket
evidence: Event type 0xe with market+0x140 + index*0x10 and three market fields at stride 0xc, same as the ELF createevent_updatecarmarket; currently named resetorientation.

name: linkitemtoitem
evidence: Checks a type compatibility table (DAT_10757498) and the slot limits, then appends the item to the parent's list and sets the child's parent/slot fields, same as the ELF linkitemtoitem; currently named item_removeitemlink.

name: scenario_setmissioninactive
evidence: Loops 5 teams x 0x10 missions, clears the mission item time-to-live, returns its stock share to the market, zeroes the mission and calls createevent_updatemission, line-for-line the ELF scenario_setmissioninactive; currently named logic_farbslist (the real logic_farbslist is 0x1d2c0).

name: stoptimer
evidence: Reads rdtsc, adds the elapsed ticks to the 64-bit accumulator of timer entry (stride 0x58) and stores the scaled result, the stop half of the resettimer/starttimer/stoptimer trio used around the physics block; currently named copyvector.

name: subtractvectors
evidence: Component-wise difference of two vectors, same as the ELF subtractvectors; currently named debug_addsphere.

name: scaleaddvectors
evidence: Computes a + s*b component-wise, same as the ELF scaleaddvectors; currently named dotproduct.

name: bullettimetolive
evidence: Called last in the dedicatedserverloop physics block where the ELF calls bullettimetolive, and decrements a time-to-live field in a record array; currently named systemtimer (the real systemtimer is 0x5350).

name: createevent_bullet
evidence: Event type 0 with two vectors and two ints, called by itemweaponsimulation right after createbullet where the ELF calls createevent_bullet; currently named getrandomvector2d.

name: createevent_sound
evidence: Event type 9 with an id, a vector and two parameters, same as the ELF createevent_sound; currently named scaleaddvectors.

name: lineintersectsphere
evidence: Distance-along-ray and perpendicular-distance test of a segment against a sphere (normalizevector, dot products, radius squared check) as in the ELF lineintersectsphere; called once by lineintersectobject like the ELF; currently named calculatebarycentric.

name: calculatebarycentric
evidence: Calls generatetrinormal and normalizevector and divides three dot products per vertex to return barycentric weights, line-for-line the ELF calculatebarycentric; called twice by lineintersectobject and sphereintersectobject like the ELF; currently named lineintersecttriangletwosided.

name: createparticle
evidence: Returns -1 above 0x3fff particles, memsets a 0xf0-byte particle record, sets time-to-live 0x10000 and copies position/velocity, same as the ELF createparticle; currently named projectvector (the real projectvector is 0xbb00).

name: objecttype_addwheel
evidence: Appends a wheel record (stride 0x44, counter at objecttype+0x775c) from 12 parameters and computes the wheel position by interpolating between two particles, same as the ELF objecttype_addwheel; currently named objecttype_addparticle (the real one is 0xb040).

name: lineintersectarea
evidence: Calls the area getters (0x1850, 0x3030), lineintersectnormalblock (0x12450) x2, lineintersectspecblock (0x126b0) x4 and lineintersectcityobjecttype (0x14dd0), exactly the ELF lineintersectarea call counts; currently named lineintersectcityobject.

name: itemtimetolive
evidence: Loops the 0x400 items, decrements the time-to-live field and deletes expired items with deleteitem inlined, called in the physics block slot of the ELF itemtimetolive; currently named deleteitem.

name: sphereintersectobject
evidence: Bounding-box test of point+radius against the object bounds, then per-face generatetrinormal, sphereintersecttrianglefull (0x307f0) and calculatebarycentric (0x22af0) calls, the ELF sphereintersectobject profile; currently named getobjectrotation2 (the real one is 0x223d0).

name: sphereintersectlevel
evidence: Calls the landscape sphere test (0x1cdf0) and sphereintersectarea (0x40aa0) per area, matching the ELF sphereintersectlevel; currently named crossproduct.
